Method of Attack: Modifies Windows Discord client JavaScript files to execute malicious behavior on startup

Collects Discord user token, timezone, screen resolution, local and public IP addresses, user info (username, email, phone), payment info, zoom factor, browser user agent, Discord version, clipboard contents
Sends collected information via Discord webhook to attacker
Executes backdoor function fightdio() to receive and execute remote commands
Potential further malware installation and payment info theft
Attack Vector: Modification of Discord client JavaScript files in %AppData%\Discord\[version]\modules\discord_modules\index.js and discord_desktop_core\index.js
Indicators of Compromise: Modified index.js files containing malicious JavaScript instead of normal single-line exports
File names such as 'Blueface Reward Claimer.exe' and 'Synapse X.exe'
Unusual Discord API and webhook calls
